title: Continuous Wave
text: Model constant envelope source, {Source type} sets Wave type Ideal; {Constant in-phase value} sets the in-phase modulations of carrier frequencies, {Constant quadrature value} sets the quadrature modulations of carrier frequencies, {Source impedance(Ohm)} sets the input impedance of source, {Available power}, {Angle(degrees)} sets the phase angle of power waves, {Carrier frequencies}, {Add phase noise}, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)}, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)}, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration}, {Impulse response duration}, {Plot phase noise characteristics} sets the phase noise magnitude and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Source type
params.values: Wave type Ideal voltage (default) | Ideal current | Power

params.name: Constant in-phase value
params.values: In-phase modulations of carrier frequencies 0 V (default) | vector of real numbers | V | mV | kV

params.name: Constant quadrature value
params.values: Quadrature modulations of carrier frequencies 0 V (default) | vector of real numbers | V | mV | kV

params.name: Source impedance(Ohm)
params.values: Input impedance of source 50 (default) | positive real number | complex number

params.name: Available power
params.values: Available power of carrier frequencies 0 W (default) | vector of real numbers | W | mW | dBW | dBm

params.name: Angle(degrees)
params.values: Phase angle of power waves 0 (default) | vector of real numbers

params.name: Carrier frequencies
params.values: Carrier frequencies 0 (default) | vector of real positive numbers | Hz | kHz | MHz | GHz

params.name: Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)
params.values: Phase noise frequency offset 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)
params.values: Phase noise level 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Automatically estimate impulse response duration
params.values: Automatically estimate impulse response duration on (default) | off

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
